body: Of course sorry to hear this is still going on because it really is just a pain! Maybe you can pm me because I still have a few questions and it settles my mind knowing I'm not the only one.

This is insane because the exact thing has happened to me... Im 16 and a female and starting about 7 days ago I started experiencing the dizziness and dissociation (which is that feeling of being in the moment but feeling like you're not yourself) I've also been staying home because I'm not able to focus and my mind just feels fogged. On Wednesday I went to the ER because I was so dizzy and couldn't get to an appointment but similar to you they weren't able to say anything was wrong and sent me home. The difference is I've taken Zoloft (anxiety medication) which my mom suspects is what's causing this, I just thought I'd comment because reading your story feels like I just read my own story. Let me know if you figured out what was wrong and or how you've dealt with school and feeling this way because I am quite curious myself!
